create_speecht5_tokenizer: create a SpeechT5 tokenizer with a SentencePiece vocabulary file and optional number normalization
build_inputs_special_tokens: build model inputs from token sequences by appending eos_token_id for SpeechT5
get_special_tokens_mask: get a special tokens mask indicating which positions are special tokens in token sequences

create_token_type_ids: create token type ids mask for sequence-pair classification tasks in SpeechT5
